high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website "Firstpost." The content of the article discusses an incident involving a helicopter that faced a "hydraulic issue" on Thursday. As a result, the helicopter had to make an unscheduled landing at a local airfield en route to Stansted Airport in England. The article mentions White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt, who noted that the incident caused the former president and first lady to be 20 minutes behind schedule.
